## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the public issue, describe the trigger and before/after behavior, and state exclusions.

## Verification

List actual commands and results, meaningful regressions, and unrun checks with reasons. For UI changes include keyboard/focus behavior and synthetic image/tree evidence. Explain new dependencies, protocol/migration compatibility and recovery constraints.

## Public/private boundary

- [ ] This diff, commit messages and attachments contain no provider identities/inventory, private research/planning, adapter implementation, private repository links, credentials, account data or publisher bodies.
- [ ] Public builds/tests need no private checkout, token or plugin binary.
- [ ] Protocol changes describe compatibility and can be tested with a synthetic provider.
- [ ] Authored code follows the doc-comments-only convention.

## Review

Record the final reviewed revision, findings and fixes. Request native Codex review when configured; do not copy confidential findings from a private adapter into this PR. The maintainer reviews the final diff and CI before merging.
